levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد
أحمد بن محمد بن أبي نصر البزنطي

notes: «قُلْتُ لأَبِي عَبْدِاللَّه» : Dawud asks the Imam, who answers; the Imam is the last link (rule 5, owner ruling 2). The surface is copied as written, «عبدالله» without the space.

The story then has Dawud (first person) meet Abu al-Hasan Musa, who speaks («عَلِيٍّ اِبْنِي»): a narrated encounter in the first person with an Imam who speaks, so the source of that part is ruled, not decided here.
«[شَيْ‏ءٍ مِنْ أَمْرِ]» is an editor's bracket in the saying, not a link.
